source.rule: The request gives one colour per chain but not which chain gets which. Accepted: every one-to-one assignment of the named colours to the polymer chains (n! states), on a cartoon of the whole polymer.
accepted_states: chain E orange, chain I cyan
chain E cyan, chain I orange
not_accepted: a colour used on two chains, or a chain left uncoloured: the request names one colour per chain
other colours, or a colour-by-chain theme with the viewer's own colours: the request names the colours
ligands, ions or water drawn or coloured: not requested

notes: Left open: which chain gets which colour. Reference = accepted state 1 of 2 (chain E orange, chain I cyan); the others are in 'accepted', in the order of provenance.accepted_states.
